components.explanation: The Lantern Gate: six visible primitives and two Blender boxes named *-convcolonly, which Godot's importer turns into collision-only static bodies (use_node_type_suffixes=true in the generated .import); lantern_gate.gd puts both on physics layer 3 with mask 0. Shown as code (B12) and as a real capture of the stand-in stopping at the base (B13).
The Supply Stack GLB exported from the MCP build: two crates and a 12-sided barrel, rotation and scale applied in Blender (B05-B08), measured in Godot (B11).
The Lamp-oil Shrine GLB: plinth, stem and an icosphere gem, re-exported by Bao with File > Export after his 20-degree hand edit of OilGem (B09); measured in Godot (B11).

The 3D prop room: floor, moon light, two practical lights, labels, the courier stand-in and the A3-R3 orbit camera (B14, B15). session.gd belongs here only for its a3_room action (F4, lines 363-364 and 399); project.godot sets the 640 x 360 stretch the room's HUD label and drag input pass through. The rest of session.gd is the Assignment 2 game.

Headless checks on the shared harness: test_a3_assets.gd (17: size, floor origin, +Y height, unit scale, budgets, material names, room placement, a caught scale mutation), test_lantern_gate.gd (14: colliders, layers, stop), test_a3_camera.gd (9: orbit, floor hiding, clamps, drag); capture_a3_orbit.gd renders the front/behind/below evidence stills.

var measured := _measure(asset)
		var bounds: AABB = measured.bounds
		var id: String = spec.name.to_lower().replace(" ", "-")
		check(id + "-size-upright-origin", bounds.size.distance_to(spec.size) <= 0.011 and absf(bounds.position.y) <= 0.011, {"position": str(bounds.position), "size": str(bounds.size), "expected": str(spec.size)})
		check(id + "-unit-scale", measured.unit_scale, {"mesh_count": _meshes(asset).size()})
		check(id + "-shape-and-triangle-budget", _meshes(asset).size() <= spec.primitives and measured.triangles <= spec.triangles, {"primitives": _meshes(asset).size(), "primitive_budget": spec.primitives, "triangles": measured.triangles, "triangle_budget": spec.triangles})
		check(id + "-materials", measured.materials == spec.materials, {"materials": measured.materials})

extends Node3D
## Applies the frozen A3 layer plan to the StaticBody3D nodes generated by
## Godot from Blender's `-convcolonly` meshes.

const PROP_LAYER := 3

func _ready() -> void:
	for body in find_children("*", "StaticBody3D", true, false):
		body.collision_layer = 0
		body.set_collision_layer_value(PROP_LAYER, true)
		body.collision_mask = 0

func orbit(d_yaw: float, d_pitch: float, d_distance := 0.0) -> void:
	yaw = wrapf(yaw + d_yaw, -PI, PI)
	pitch = clampf(pitch + d_pitch, PITCH_MIN, PITCH_MAX)
	distance = clampf(distance + d_distance, DISTANCE_MIN, DISTANCE_MAX)
	_place_camera()

func _place_camera() -> void:
	camera.position = ORBIT_TARGET + Vector3(sin(yaw) * cos(pitch), sin(pitch), cos(yaw) * cos(pitch)) * distance
	camera.look_at(ORBIT_TARGET)
	# Below the floor's top only its picture is hidden; the floor collider stays.
	floor_mesh.visible = camera.position.y >= 0.0
